"""Constant table for flapsim. All values are centi-units (integers)."""

FIELD_H = 1200     # playfield height
BIRD_X = 300       # bird's fixed horizontal position
BIRD_W = 80        # bird width
BIRD_H = 80        # bird height

G = 18             # gravity added to vy each tick
FLAP_V = -27       # vy is SET to this on a flap (not added)
VY_MAX = 260       # terminal downward speed

SCROLL = 40        # how far pipes move left per tick
PIPE_W = 120       # pipe width
GAP_H = 1000       # vertical gap height
SPAWN_X = 2000     # x at which a new pipe appears
SPAWN_EVERY = 45   # spawn when t % SPAWN_EVERY == 0
GLIDE_VY = 40      # |vy| at or below this counts as a clean glide

"""Per-tick bird physics: flap/gravity, integration, ceiling and floor."""

from units import G, FLAP_V, VY_MAX, FIELD_H, BIRD_H


def step_bird(y, vy, flap):
    """Advance the bird one tick. Returns (y, vy, alive).

    A flap SETS vy to FLAP_V (never clamped). Gravity adds G and is
    clamped at VY_MAX. The ceiling is soft (clamps y, zeroes vy); the
    floor kills the bird.
    """
    if flap:
        vy = FLAP_V
    else:
        vy = min(vy + G, VY_MAX)
    y += vy
    alive = True
    if y < 0:
        y = 0
        vy = 0
    elif y + BIRD_H > FIELD_H:
        y = FIELD_H - BIRD_H
        alive = False
    return y, vy, alive

"""World generation: the LCG and pipe spawning, scrolling, culling."""

from units import SPAWN_X, SCROLL, PIPE_W


def lcg(s):
    """Advance the LCG once; return the new state."""
    return (1103515245 * s + 12345) % 2147483648


def spawn(t, s):
    """If tick t is a spawn tick, return (new_state, pipe_or_None).

    The LCG advances exactly once per spawn, before the gap is computed.
    """
    if t % SPAWN_EVERY != 0:
        return s, None
    s = lcg(s)
    gap_top = 40 + (s >> 8) % 80
    pipe = {"x": SPAWN_X, "gap_top": gap_top, "passed": False}
    return s, pipe


def scroll(pipes):
    """Move every pipe left by SCROLL (in place)."""
    for p in pipes:
        p["x"] -= SCROLL


def cull(pipes):
    """Drop every pipe whose right edge is at or behind x=0.

    Must run after scoring so a culled pipe can never be scored again.
    Returns the surviving list.
    """
    return [p for p in pipes if p["x"] + PIPE_W > 0]

"""Axis-aligned collision with half-open intervals. Edges do not collide."""

from units import BIRD_X, BIRD_W, BIRD_H, PIPE_W, GAP_H


def rect_overlap(a0, a1, b0, b1):
    """True iff the half-open intervals [a0,a1) and [b0,b1) overlap."""
    return a0 < b1 and b0 < a1


def pipe_hit(y, pipe):
    """True if the bird at height y hits the given pipe.

    The bird occupies [BIRD_X, BIRD_X+BIRD_W) x [y, y+BIRD_H). A hit
    requires horizontal overlap AND being outside the open gap
    [gap_top, gap_top+GAP_H).
    """
    x = pipe["x"]
    gap_top = pipe["gap_top"]
    horizontal = rect_overlap(BIRD_X, BIRD_X + BIRD_W, x, x + PIPE_W)
    outside = y < gap_top or y + BIRD_H > gap_top + GAP_H
    return horizontal and outside
